reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, DATE '2026-01-05' - launch_date AS days_since_launch
FROM products
WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
alternatives: SELECT product_id, date_diff('day', launch_date, DATE '2026-01-05') AS days_since_launch FROM products WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
SELECT product_id, datediff('day', launch_date, DATE '2026-01-05') AS days_since_launch FROM products WHERE launch_date > DATE '2023-12-31'

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, date_diff('day', launch_date, DATE '2026-01-05') AS days_since_launch FROM products WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
other_way.tradeoff: date_diff('day', ...) gives the same number on dates, but on timestamps it counts the midnights crossed, not 24-hour days.

SELECT product_id, DATE '2026-01-05' - launch_date AS days_since_launch FROM products WHERE launch_date > DATE '2024-01-01'

solver.query:

FROM products
WHERE CAST(launch_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-01-01'
